facts.fact: Human Rights Watch reports journalist Chahana Takiou was convicted and sentenced to one year in prison on 3 August 2026 for criticising the prosecution of a fellow journalist; Abdramane Keita was also arrested on 9 June 2026 after comments on television.

Human Rights Watch reports Chahana Takiou, editor of the biweekly 22 Septembre, publicly criticised the authorities for prosecuting journalist Youssouf Sissoko under the cybercrime law rather than the press laws.
